You can make shapes in the two-dimensional plane with these vectors in the following fashion: Start at the origin $$$(0, 0)$$$. Choose a vector and add the segment of the vector to the current point. For example, if your current point is at $$$(x, y)$$$ and you choose the vector $$$(u, v)$$$, draw a segment from your current point to the point at $$$(x + u, y + v)$$$ and set your current point to $$$(x + u, y + v)$$$.
